newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma flat,zeros firm,long-end forwards down.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma flat,zeros firm,long-end forwards down.

text.p: Greek interbank depos were holding, forex forwards were softer in longer tenors, two-year zeros were firmer and ecu/drachma was trading tightly close to its intraday upper range in late dealings, traders said.
"Depos are little changed and implied drachma rates from forex forwards are softer about 10 basis points for no particular reason," said a trader at a private bank.
Bond dealers said prices of fixed coupon bonds and FRNs were little changed in late trade but two-year zeros firmed about 30 basis points on strong demand from abroad.
The mark was quoted at 159.45/55 from Tuesday's 159.595 fix, the dollar at 270.69/79 drachmas from 270.980 and the ecu at 310.56/66 from 310.520 drachmas.
"Ecu/drachma is trading around 310.65/75 in late dealings," said a forex trader at a foreign bank. "This is the upper range of its intraday fluctuation band."
